Contractually the Tokenizer may freeze tokens, rescind putative transfers made in violation of the Sales Terms, cancel tokens 'with or without making any payment therefor', pause all transfers, and execute BVI-recognised court orders. On-chain today only freeze and pause are wired; the burn function is limited to tokens held by the Tokenizer itself.

The compliance perimeter is auditable even though the identities behind it are not.

Stock splits and reverse splits are applied at the mint via the Token-2022 ScaledUiAmount extension rather than by reissuing tokens, and the multiplier is published both on-chain (scaledUiAmountConfig, 1 on FWDI and HSDT) and off-chain (equity_info.current_split_multiplier), so corporate actions do not break holder balances or DeFi positions.

'shareholders can now hold BLSH ordinary shares as tokens on the Solana blockchain'; 'EQ maintains the official record of ownership whether shares are held in book-entry form or token form'. One class, one register, two forms, corroborated by arithmetic: mint supply 151,810,063.5 against 150,833,916 ordinary shares outstanding at 2025-12-31.

'EQ maintains the official record of ownership whether shares are held in book-entry form or token form, and shareholders can move between the two through EQ's Shareholder Central portal.' This contradicts the same release's 'single authoritative ledger' phrasing; the register-assigning sentence controls. No document states which record prevails if the chain and EQ's register disagree, or who bears the loss.

'Transfers of onchain BLSH today move bilaterally between EQ-whitelisted wallet addresses ... Any attempt to send BLSH tokens to a non-whitelisted address will fail at the smart-contract level.' Verified on-chain: the mint carries defaultAccountState=Frozen, so every new token account is frozen at birth, and the freeze authority is the single wallet 4Be7JXd6JaiXd6KkSMBEya5yt19gq1d11NEWTZC6Bsgk. There is no allowlist program, so the restriction is verifiable but its membership is not.

The mint carries a permanent delegate (DPT54eBQJf7ghEQTzX7vjAb8WaDRMJFQchX6MKm3dFcD) able to transfer or burn from any token account without the holder's signature, a freeze authority (4Be7JXd6JaiXd6KkSMBEya5yt19gq1d11NEWTZC6Bsgk) able to freeze any account, and a pausable extension able to halt every transfer of the mint at once. Positive for legal integration in this vocabulary and a concentrated governance risk at the same time.

attestor: US Securities and Exchange Commission (registration record), asserted by Securitize Corp.
statement: Securitize Transfer Agent, LLC (CIK 0001782266) is a registered transfer agent, SEC File No. 084-06638, with a long live filing history. Critical qualifier for grading: the transfer agent is an affiliate of the issuer, not an independent third party. Satisfied on its face and not to be read as independence.

'On Closing Date, we enabled Tokenized SECZ, a natively tokenized version of our common stock. Tokenized SECZ is not a separate share class.' Made in a Form S-1 under Securities Act liability, which is a stronger evidentiary posture than a press release.

'issuer-sponsored tokenization of the same common stock trading on the NYSE'; 'Tokenization changes the form of ownership; it does not change the underlying nature of the share or override applicable legal, contractual or transfer restrictions.' S-1: 'holders of SECZ may elect to switch between tokenized SECZ and nontokenized SECZ'. Unresolved: whether the tokenized holder is a holder of record in their own name or a customer position behind the group's broker-dealer.

'While tokenized securities may exist across multiple blockchains through authorized multichain issuance, such deployments are managed and reconciled through the same control book and master securityholder file to ensure that total outstanding units remain consistent and singular across chains.' Reinforced twice: 'Securitize would determine which chain constitutes the valid and authoritative record'; and Securitize retains manual safeguards over the records in its capacity as transfer agent.

attestor: Securitize Corp. (S-1 and Connect API docs)
statement: 'Access to Tokenized SECZ is restricted to holders who meet the onboarding requirements of Securities Markets, LLC, a SEC registered and FINRA member broker dealer', implemented as a per-token wallet whitelist. The whitelist itself is not publicly enumerable.

The gate is a FINRA-member broker-dealer's customer onboarding, a higher bar than platform KYC: 'Access to Tokenized SECZ is restricted to holders who meet the onboarding requirements of Securities Markets, LLC, a SEC registered and FINRA member broker dealer'. Corroborated institutionally by the S-1's manual safeguards over ownership records and by the fork provisions under which Securitize may decline to recognise tokens or migrate assets.

The role is named: Securitize acting 'in its capacity as transfer agent', an SEC-registered transfer agent (File No. 084-06638), is the party that controls the records and the safeguards and that would determine which chain is authoritative. Solution Overview: "For every Series Token in circulation, this entity holds the corresponding leveraged or inverse ETF on a 1:1 basis ... There are no fractional reserves. Recorded unknown: no proof-of-reserve feed, attestation, custodian confirmation or holdings report exists, the claimed Chainlink PoR gating is absent from every observed mint transaction, and the SPCX2S mint was issued while the issuer's own pages said the underlying instrument was not yet available.
